# MCP Tool Reference

Generated from `src/mcp/registry/toolRegistry.ts`. Do not edit this file manually.

Every row below is generated from the complete captured tool definition, handler, input schema, and policy in the canonical registry. The registry is the sole runtime registration and documentation input.

## Result Contract

Successful tool calls return JSON text with `ok: true`; domain-level `ok: false` values are preserved as `resultOk: false` without making the MCP call a transport error.
Failed tool calls return JSON text with `ok: false`, `status: failed`, `remote_failed`, or `ambiguous`, and `error: { code, message, retryable }`. `ambiguous` is reserved for audited mutation failures where the remote outcome cannot be known. HTTP 5xx read/proposal failures are `remote_failed` and retryable, not ambiguous.
Write status is reported by `nodel.get_write_status`: `read_only`, `writes_with_approval`, or `writes_without_approval`; unavailable tools are not registered.
Tool-specific success output schemas are not claimed because handlers return domain payloads without a single stable output schema.

| Tool | Capability | Stability | Gate | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nodel.ping` | read | preview | always | Return a timestamp and optional echo payload to verify MCP connectivity. |
| `nodel.get_workflow_guidance` | read | preview | always | Return task-specific MCP workflow guidance that adapts to write, approval, lifecycle, and delete gates. |
| `nodel.get_write_status` | read | preview | always | Summarize write-related gates, available write tools, and recommended next steps for the current sidecar configuration. |
| `nodel.verify_write_plan` | read | preview | always | Read-only consistency check for a proposed or dry-run write plan before operator approval or apply. This is guidance only; write tools still enforce safety gates. |
| `nodel.get_ui_guidelines` | read | preview | always | Return bundled legacy v1 XML/XSLT dashboard construction guidance and a component index. |
| `nodel.get_ui_component_reference` | read | preview | always | Return filtered source-backed v1 XML component markup, classes, point rules, CSS defaults, and practical CSS recipes. |
| `nodel.verify_ui_file` | read | preview | always | Validate a saved or proposed legacy v1 XML UI against XML/XSLT rules, live node points/schemas, assets, and detected Frontend parser behavior. |
| `nodel.health` | read | preview | always | Return sidecar configuration and optionally verify Nodel reachability via GET /REST. |
| `nodel.list_nodes` | read | preview | always | List all discoverable Nodel nodes via POST /REST/nodeURLs. |
| `nodel.list_local_nodes` | read | preview | always | List only nodes hosted by the local Nodel runtime via GET /REST. |
| `nodel.list_write_audit` | read | preview | always | Read recent sidecar write audit JSONL entries, including retained rotations, from NODEL_STATE_DIR without modifying state. Legacy records are reported as attempted, never successful. |
| `nodel.list_config_backups` | read | preview | always | List parameter and binding backup files saved before sidecar config writes. |
| `nodel.read_config_backup` | read | preview | always | Read one parameter or binding backup file from NODEL_STATE_DIR/backups. Path traversal outside the backup directory is rejected. |
| `nodel.get_node_actions` | read | preview | always | Inspect callable actions via GET REST/actions, with optional exact-name or safe-regex filtering and summary-only output. |
| `nodel.get_node_signals` | read | preview | always | Inspect node signals/events via GET REST/events, with optional exact-name or safe-regex filtering and summary-only output. |
| `nodel.get_node_bindings` | read | preview | always | Inspect configured remote bindings/schema, with optional exact-name or safe-regex filtering, summary-only output, and status. |
| `nodel.get_node_files` | read | preview | always | Read node recipe file lists and capped text file contents via REST/files endpoints. |
| `nodel.get_node_activity` | read | preview | always | Read action, signal, and binding activity via GET REST/activity. |
| `nodel.get_node_console` | read | preview | always | Read recipe console logs via GET REST/console without executing console code. |
| `nodel.get_logs` | read | preview | always | Compatibility wrapper for read-only activity and console logs. Prefer nodel.get_node_activity or nodel.get_node_console. |
| `nodel.verify_node_ready` | read | preview | always | Read-only readiness summary for a node using selected REST probes and current-runtime console error heuristics. Useful after writes or ambiguous reloads. |
| `nodel.read_recipe` | read | preview | always | Read recipe source files from a node via REST/files and REST/files/contents. |
| `nodel.get_recipe_guidelines` | read | preview | always | Return local Nodel recipe authoring/debugging guidelines. |
| `nodel.list_public_recipes` | read | preview | always | List public recipes from museumsvictoria/nodel-recipes. |
| `nodel.read_public_recipe` | read | preview | always | Read selected files from a public museumsvictoria/nodel-recipes recipe directory. |
| `nodel.read_toolkit` | read | preview | always | Read the Nodel scripting toolkit from /REST/Toolkit. |
| `nodel.approve_write` | write | experimental | writes | Manual/fallback approval path. Create a short-lived approval id only after explicit operator approval of the matching full proposalHash and confirmText. This is a workflow guardrail dependent on client/operator discipline, not an authentication boundary. |
| `nodel.request_write_approval` | write | experimental | writes | Ask the MCP client to elicit operator confirmation for a proposed write where supported, then mint the same approval id as nodel.approve_write. Falls back to manual approval instructions when elicitation is unavailable. |
| `nodel.read_signal` | read | preview | always | Read a signal/event value by name. Endpoint behavior is runtime-dependent; falls back to REST/events/<name>. |
| `nodel.get_node_parameters` | read | preview | always | Read node parameters using the conventional REST/params endpoint. |
| `nodel.propose_node_bindings` | proposal | experimental | always | Plan remote action/event bindings from one node to a target node using binding schema and target actions/signals. No changes are applied. Use nodel.verify_write_plan before approval/apply. |
| `nodel.propose_context_bindings` | proposal | experimental | always | Plan remote bindings for a frontend, dashboard, group, or control node by discovering likely target equipment from a room/context phrase and matching source binding names to target actions/signals. Use nodel.verify_write_plan before approval/apply. |
| `nodel.call_action` | write | experimental | writes | Call a node action with optional args. Side effects require NODEL_ENABLE_WRITES=true. |
| `nodel.set_node_parameter` | write | experimental | writes | Safely set one node parameter by reading REST/params, merging this value into the current parameter object, then POSTing the full result to Nodel's replace-only REST/params/save endpoint. Waits for post-write node readiness by default because Nodel may restart the node. Side effects require NODEL_ENABLE_WRITES=true. |
| `nodel.patch_node_parameters` | write | experimental | writes | Preferred partial parameter update helper. Reads REST/params, deep-merges values into the current parameter object, optionally removes explicit removePaths, then POSTs the full result to Nodel's replace-only REST/params/save endpoint. Null values are assigned, not deleted. Use nodel.verify_write_plan before approval/apply. |
| `nodel.set_node_parameters` | write | experimental | writes | Set multiple node parameters. Defaults to mode=merge, which reads REST/params and deep-merges values into the current parameter object, optionally removes explicit removePaths, then POSTs the full result to Nodel's replace-only REST/params/save endpoint. Use removePaths to delete explicit keys. Use mode=replace only for a full binding overwrite. Waits for post-write node readiness by default because Nodel may restart the node. Side effects require NODEL_ENABLE_WRITES=true. |
| `nodel.patch_node_bindings` | write | experimental | writes | Preferred partial binding update helper. Reads REST/remote, deep-merges bindings into the current binding object, optionally removes explicit removePaths, then POSTs the full result to Nodel's replace-only REST/remote/save endpoint. Null values are assigned, not deleted. Use nodel.verify_write_plan before approval/apply. |
| `nodel.set_node_bindings` | write | experimental | writes | Set remote bindings. Defaults to mode=merge, which reads REST/remote and deep-merges bindings into the current binding object, optionally removes explicit removePaths. Use mode=replace only for a full binding overwrite. |
| `nodel.apply_node_binding_plan` | write | experimental | writes | Plan and apply remote bindings from one node to a target node. Requires NODEL_ENABLE_WRITES=true unless dryRun is true. Use nodel.verify_write_plan before approval/apply. |
| `nodel.describe_node` | read | preview | always | Resolve a node and return key read-only metadata for planning. |
| `nodel.verify_recipe_script` | read | preview | always | Run heuristic static analysis of a Python recipe file or composed recipe load order for likely Python 2.5/Jython 2.5 and import/call-policy issues. It has false positives and false negatives, is not a complete parser, and requires runtime verification in Nodel. |
| `nodel.propose_recipe_script` | proposal | experimental | always | Read the current main Python recipe script and propose a full replacement. Script saves use REST/script/save, reload the node, and require recipe validation plus post-save readiness checks. |
| `nodel.propose_recipe_script_edit` | proposal | experimental | always | Read the main Python recipe script and apply exact text replacements in memory without modifying the node. |
| `nodel.propose_node_file_text` | proposal | experimental | always | Read a supporting node file and propose a text save via REST/files/save. This rejects script.py, does not reload the node, and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.propose_node_file_base64` | proposal | experimental | always | Read a supporting node file and propose a base64/binary save via REST/files/save. This rejects script.py, does not reload the node, and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.propose_node_file_edit` | proposal | experimental | always | Read a supporting text file and apply exact text replacements in memory without modifying the node. This rejects script.py and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.save_recipe_script` | write | experimental | writes | Save the main Python recipe script via REST/script/save. This reloads the node, blocks invalid recipes, and waits for post-save readiness by default. |
| `nodel.apply_recipe_script_edit` | write | experimental | writes | Apply approved exact text replacements to the main Python recipe script via REST/script/save. This reloads the node and waits for readiness by default. |
| `nodel.save_node_file_text` | write | experimental | writes | Save a supporting text file via REST/files/save. Rejects script.py, does not reload the node, and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.save_node_file_base64` | write | experimental | writes | Save a supporting binary/base64 file via REST/files/save. Rejects script.py, does not reload the node, and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.apply_node_file_edit` | write | experimental | writes | Apply exact text replacements to a supporting text file via REST/files/save. Rejects script.py, does not reload the node, and does not run recipe validation. |
| `nodel.restart_node` | lifecycle | experimental | lifecycle | Restart a node. Requires NODEL_ENABLE_WRITES=true and NODEL_ENABLE_NODE_LIFECYCLE=true unless dryRun is true. |
| `nodel.create_node` | lifecycle | experimental | lifecycle | Create a node on the local runtime, or on an explicit remote Nodel runtimeUrl. Requires lifecycle writes unless dryRun is true. |
| `nodel.delete_node` | delete | experimental | deletes | Delete a node. Requires writes, lifecycle, delete gate, and exact name confirmation unless dryRun is true. |
